## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you would like to see implemented.

## Problem This Feature Solves
Explain what problem this feature would solve or what value it would add to the module.

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working. Include any specific implementation details you have in mind.

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, code examples, or references about the feature request here.
